(rule!
 ;; Smear every non-zero cell DOWN to the bottom edge (in scan order, so a
 ;; lower source in the same column overwrites from its row downward).
 (for*/fold ((out g)) ((r (in-range h)) (c (in-range w)))
   (let ((v (at g r c)))
     (if (= v 0)
         out
         (paint-cells out (map (lambda (rr) (list rr c)) (range r h)) v)))))
